title: DealsProductResolveRequest
description: deals.product-resolve-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/products/resolve on OpenVibe.Deals (deals.product.resolve): product aliases (gtin 8-14 digits, mpn, sku, url, name) to find the product by; with create (default true) a product is made when none matches (name then required, 2-200 characters).
